subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should context-engine control be a direct HTTP-only Gateway surface, a dispatchable Gateway RPC surface, or deferred until the context-engine plugin API contract is explicitly sponsored?
rationale: The PR adds a new core/plugin control API with security, session-state, and compatibility impact; automation can fix mechanics only after the intended public surface is chosen.

options.title: Sponsor a single Gateway API shape
options.body: Choose HTTP-only or RPC-first, then require the patch to align descriptors, handlers, docs, and tests to that one surface before merge.

options.title: Accept experimental HTTP-only control
options.body: Keep the direct HTTP endpoints but hide/remove the contextEngine.* method catalog entries and document the API as a narrow operator surface.

options.title: Pause core control API
options.body: Close or hold this PR if context-engine rotation/status should remain plugin-owned until a broader control-plane design is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a single Gateway API shape
recommendation.body: Choose HTTP-only or RPC-first, then require the patch to align descriptors, handlers, docs, and tests to that one surface before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the clearest history on the context-engine abstraction that this API extends.
